description.value:
You activate a personal light-bending cloaking device, becoming completely invisible to enemies while setting up a devastating ambush strike.

You become Undetected by all creatures until the start of your next turn or until you make a Strike, whichever comes first. You gain the Tactical Cloak effect, which adds +3d6 precision damage to your first Strike made while Undetected and makes its target off-guard to it. The dice are multiplied as the creature's other powers are: doubled at 4th level, tripled at 8th, and multiplied by 4 at 12th, by 5 at 16th and by 6 at 20th. The effect comes off by itself after that Strike.

Recharge The creature can't use this power again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

NPC version. Use it from the chat card to apply its effect.
